capabilities.acceptance: /portfolio/ is directly addressable and does not use dialog or iframe for the main application
scanner selection navigates to /portfolio/ and preserves source job, dates, benchmark and coverage threshold
up to five active portfolios are supported
each portfolio supports up to twenty unique assets
desktop asset by portfolio matrix and mobile portfolio-focused editor are both usable
symbols are unique and every active portfolio totals 100 percent within the published tolerance
all portfolio values use the existing daily TWD valuation contract
asset and FX calendars use union valuation with forward fill only after observation and no look-ahead
one symbol or portfolio failure does not erase unrelated successful histories or portfolios
TWD price return, cash distribution return and total return are separately auditable
split, reverse split, distributions and repair metadata remain auditable
fixed periodic contributions and withdrawals support beginning or end timing and annual growth
portfolio-value percentage contributions and withdrawals are path dependent and capped safely
cash distributions can be reinvested or retained as TWD cash without double counting adjusted close
none, monthly, quarterly, semiannual and annual rebalancing are supported with a fixed event-order contract
maximum absolute weight drift can independently trigger rebalancing
traded notional incurs configurable basis-point cost and is reported separately
fixed-ratio leverage updates debt consistently after external flows and rebalancing
fixed debt, daily interest and equity are represented in the portfolio ledger
maintenance-margin breach produces an auditable liquidation event rather than an API error
total return, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, maximum drawdown, beta and alpha use the unified metric context
XIRR reports unique, multiple or no-solution status and never silently chooses an ambiguous root
historical daily VaR and CVaR are explicitly labelled with method and confidence
top drawdown events include peak, trough, recovery, depth and duration
incomplete first or last year and month are marked partial
factor analysis states regression currency, sample, source and separates asset factors from FX exposure
style exposures use non-negative coefficients constrained to sum to one
market, volatility, inflation and business-cycle regimes expose thresholds, sample sizes and limitations
nominal and real results identify the CPI series and currency limitation
overview, growth, drawdown, annual, monthly, income, allocation, analytics and audit views are available
quote currencies, FX path, coverage, repairs, fingerprints and contract versions are visible
local save, secret-free share URL, JSON import/export and result CSV/JSON export are supported
keyboard, screen reader, reduced motion, high contrast, desktop and 390px mobile acceptance tests pass
production runtime contains no old API origin, old Pages path, portfolio-lab proxy route or dialog identifier
legacy GitHub Pages, Vercel project and repository are removed only after the documented observation gate
